name: Octree-based Address Translation
definition: An address translation method using an octree structure where the down-sampling ratio between resolution levels is intrinsically coupled to the spatial subdivision, such that each node corresponds to exactly one brick in the data set.
summary: Octree-based Address Translation tightly couples spatial subdivision with resolution levels to simplify address calculation, though it requires keeping the entire root-to-leaf path in cache, leading to potential memory overhead.
